documents.title: Library opening times
documents.text: The Cedar community library closes at 17:30 on Saturday. On Sunday the library is closed. Weekday closing time is 19:00.

documents.title: Laptop borrowing
documents.text: Members may borrow a library laptop for three days. Laptops must be returned to the equipment desk. Library books may be borrowed for twenty-one days.

documents.title: Book renewals
documents.text: A book can be renewed twice if nobody has reserved it. A reserved book cannot be renewed. Laptop loans cannot be extended.

documents.title: Late return charges
documents.text: Late laptop returns cost two credits per day. Late book returns have no daily charge. Lost equipment is reviewed separately.

documents.title: Quiet study area
documents.text: The upstairs study room is a quiet area. Phone calls belong in the ground-floor lobby. Group discussions use the workshop rooms.

documents.title: Step-free access
documents.text: A ramp at the east entrance provides step-free access. The west staircase has no ramp. An elevator connects the lobby to the upstairs study room.

documents.title: Document printing
documents.text: Black-and-white printing costs one credit for ten pages. Color printing costs one credit per page. The printer accepts PDF documents.

documents.title: Wireless internet
documents.text: Guest Wi-Fi is available in the lobby without a library card. The workshop network requires an event pass. Passwords are issued at reception.

documents.title: Wren workshop room
documents.text: The Wren workshop room seats twelve people. Wren has a projector and a whiteboard. The Birch team maintains Wren.

documents.title: Lark workshop room
documents.text: The Lark workshop room seats eight people. Lark has a whiteboard but no projector. The Aspen team maintains Lark.

documents.title: Birch maintenance contact
documents.text: The Birch maintenance team can be reached at extension 42. Birch handles projector repairs for its assigned rooms. Urgent requests go to reception.

documents.title: Aspen maintenance contact
documents.text: The Aspen maintenance team can be reached at extension 57. Aspen handles seating repairs for its assigned rooms. Urgent requests go to reception.

documents.title: Room reservation rules
documents.text: Workshop rooms can be reserved seven days ahead. A reservation lasts at most two hours. Reception confirms the booking code.

documents.title: Cancel a room reservation
documents.text: Room reservations must be cancelled at least twenty-four hours before the event. Contact reception and include the booking code. A library membership remains active after a room cancellation.

documents.title: Close a library account
documents.text: Closing a library account requires returning all borrowed items. Reception removes the membership after checking the returns. This policy does not change library opening hours.

documents.title: Evening science event
documents.text: The science club event ends at 18:00 on Saturday. It takes place in Wren. Event closing time differs from library closing time.

documents.title: Battery disposal
documents.text: Used household batteries go into the marked collection box at reception. Batteries must not go into the paper recycling bin. Damaged batteries require staff assistance.

documents.title: Equipment orientation
documents.text: Members need a safety orientation before using the soldering station. The orientation runs on Tuesday. The library laptop desk does not require this workshop training.

documents.title: Animal access
documents.text: Assistance dogs are permitted inside the community center. Other pets stay outside. Animals are not counted as workshop seats.

documents.title: Cafe drinks
documents.text: The cafe serves tea and coffee. It stops serving hot drinks at 16:45 on Saturday. Cafe hours do not determine the library closing time.

documents.title: Aurora project room
documents.text: The Aurora project is assigned to the Wren workshop room. Project participants use the room reservation rules. The room maintenance team is listed in the room guide.

documents.title: Lost event passes
documents.text: A lost event pass should be reported to reception. Reception disables the old pass before issuing a replacement. This process does not reset a Wi-Fi password.

documents.title: Archive access
documents.text: The local history archive opens by appointment on Wednesday. Visitors request an appointment at reception. The archive does not provide current room availability.
